pages.title: About
pages.text: A dwarf planet at the edge of the system. Tier 6 rocket. Gravity is about 27% of Earth's. It is among the coldest worlds, with real temperatures below -200 °C. Charon only stays on the map. From here a telescope sees $(l:space/planets/proxima)Proxima B$().

pages.title: What is here
pages.text: An alpha wolf guards the treasure. Bring tier 4 thermal protection and plenty of oxygen: home is far away.
